payload.title: Competitive gaps from Hankweave comparison
payload.description: As a Tactus maintainer, I want to close the gaps found in the Hankweave comparison (research/hankweave-vs-tactus.md), so that Tactus is clearly ahead for long-running production agent work. Definition of done: run spend budgets shipped, a coding-agent step available to procedures, a Why Tactus page published, and a release cut that no longer says alpha. Not included: copying Hankweave's fixed JSON plan model.
